label: HaloPSA Resource Server
helpText: Base HaloPSA resource server URL. Phase 3a keeps connection validation read-only.

label: HaloPSA Authorisation Server
helpText: Base HaloPSA authorisation server URL used for OAuth token acquisition.

label: HaloPSA Client Secret
helpText: HaloPSA OAuth client secret. The stored value remains masked after save.

label: Halo Team ID
helpText: Optional default Halo team ID. Phase 3b loads read-only Halo team options in the settings UI.

label: Halo Ticket Type ID
helpText: Optional default Halo ticket type ID. Phase 3b loads read-only Halo ticket type options in the settings UI.

label: Halo Category 1 ID
helpText: Optional default Halo category ID. Category options refresh from HaloPSA without saving discovery data.

label: Halo New Ticket Status ID
helpText: Optional status ID to apply to newly created Halo tickets. Status options refresh from HaloPSA without changing saved settings.

label: Halo Closed Status IDs
helpText: Halo status IDs that should be treated as closed. Phase 3b adds a read-only multi-select helper while keeping Marketplace storage durable.

label: Existing Open Ticket Behavior
helpText: Choose whether HaloPSA should update or skip an already-open linked ticket.

label: Close When Signal Clears
helpText: Allow future lifecycle logic to close linked tickets when the underlying signal clears.

label: Create New When Linked Ticket Is Closed
helpText: Allow future lifecycle logic to create a new ticket when the linked Halo ticket is already closed.

label: Offline Threshold Days
helpText: Minimum number of days an endpoint must remain offline before it qualifies.

label: Vulnerability Severities
helpText: Comma-separated severity list. Multi-select discovery controls are deferred to Phase 3b.

label: Vulnerability Remediation Statuses
helpText: Comma-separated remediation statuses. Phase 3a stores this as text until richer controls are added.

label: Update Severities
helpText: Comma-separated severity list. Multi-select discovery controls are deferred to Phase 3b.

label: Update Remediation Statuses
helpText: Comma-separated remediation statuses. Phase 3a stores this as text until richer controls are added.

label: Max Impacted Endpoints In Grouped Ticket
helpText: Cap the number of impacted endpoints listed in grouped ticket content.

label: Max Open Tickets Per Organization
helpText: Safeguard limit for future lifecycle orchestration.
